problem: A fictional consumer-software company's support tickets sat in a shared queue waiting for a human to read and route them, creating a bottleneck before any real work began.
approach: Trained a classifier on historical tickets paired with the team that ultimately resolved each one. Deployed it at intake; high-confidence predictions were routed automatically and lower-confidence ones went to a small human review queue.
impact: Median time-to-first-response dropped from hours to under an hour, and specialists reported fewer mis-routed tickets reaching their queues.
